news.title: Mitchell scores 26 as Cavaliers rally and defeat Timberwolves 127-125 in overtime
news.text: — Donovan Mitchell had 26 points, including five points in overtime, and the Cleveland Cavaliers defeated the Minnesota Timberwolves 127-125 despite 47 points from Anthony Edwards.

news.title: Timberwolves stay unbeaten with 117-94 win over Raptors in home opener
news.text: — Anthony Edwards scored 26 points in 27 minutes to lead a hot-shooting home opener for the Minnesota Timberwolves in a 117-94 victory Sunday over a Toronto Raptors team

news.title: Despite low output from Anthony Edwards, Timberwolves dominate glass and roll Magic 115-93
news.text: — Anthony Edwards and Jaden McDaniels each scored 15 points to help the Minnesota Timberwolves beat the Orlando Magic 115-93 on Friday night.

news.title: Anthony Edwards joins Chamberlain, Jordan after dropping 40 in another opener
news.text: Anthony Edwards joined legends Wilt Chamberlain and Michael Jordan as the only players in NBA history with multiple 40-point games in season openers.

news.title: Anthony Edwards scores 45, Wolves roll past Heat 131-106 to spoil Giannis' opener
news.text: — Anthony Edwards hit nine 3-pointers and scored 45 points to join an elite club, LaMelo Ball scored 21 in his Minnesota debut and the Timberwolves spoiled Giannis Antetokounmpo's first game with Miami by beating the Heat 131-106 on Wednesday night.
